title: Moral Reasoning Across Languages: The Critical Role of Low-Resource Languages in LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark (MMRB) measures moral reasoning abilities of large language models based on scenarios with varying contextual complexity (sentence, paragraph, document). The evaluation is based on ethical frameworks including justice, well-being, virtues, deontology, and consequentialism. It does not specifically measure any aspects of faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on the consistency of moral reasoning across different languages and the impact of low-resource languages on model performance.
